name: EngagementPageContent
description: One engagement offer page: a breadcrumb back to Pricing, problem, fit signals, scope and limits, steps, deliverables, investment, published proof, an offer FAQ, the procurement FAQ, the other engagements and a booking call to action.

keyboard: Tab reaches the calls to action, links and FAQ triggers in reading order; Enter or Space toggles an FAQ item.
ariaRequirements: The article is labelled by its single h1; each section is labelled by its h2.
Steps are an ordered list; decorative numbers and icons are hidden from assistive technology.
Proof links carry the case title in a visually hidden suffix so repeated link text stays distinguishable.

className.description: Additional class name on the root.

forbiddenUse: Show a claim, figure or client outcome that is not published elsewhere on the site.
Repeat a procurement question in the offer FAQ.
dense: Engagement offer page from data/engagements and engagementPages locale copy: hero, fit, scope, steps, deliverables, price, proof, FAQs, booking

usage.description: Renders /engagements/<slug>. Copy lives under engagementPages.<id> in the locales; routes, contact links, price keys and proof order in data/engagements.
